name: pos
description: Five projects, each runs alone (docs/11-multi-branch.md §8). This file only holds shortcuts: it has no packages of its own.

scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix branch-server run typecheck && npm --prefix cloud-hq run typecheck && npm --prefix till run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:tests: npm --prefix branch-server run typecheck:tests && npm --prefix cloud-hq run typecheck:tests && npm --prefix till run typecheck:tests
scripts.test: npm --prefix branch-server run test && npm --prefix cloud-hq run test && npm --prefix till run test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix branch-server run lint && npm --prefix cloud-hq run lint && npm --prefix till run lint
scripts.format: npm --prefix branch-server run format && npm --prefix cloud-hq run format && npm --prefix till run format
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix branch-server run format:check && npm --prefix cloud-hq run format:check && npm --prefix till run format:check
